headline: Meta and Roblox Agree to Strengthen Child-Safety Measures in the Philippines
seoTitle: Meta, Roblox Strengthen Child Safety in Philippines | FMB News
seoDescription: Meta and Roblox announced stronger online-safety commitments in the Philippines, including PhilSys-linked Roblox verification and cooperation with lawful investigations.
deck: Roblox committed to PhilSys-linked verification and age-group safeguards, while Meta pledged action on harmful AI deepfakes and cooperation with lawful investigations.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Meta and Roblox agreed to strengthen online-safety protections following meetings between company representatives and Philippine cybersecurity officials in Singapore.

Meta committed to more proactive action against harmful AI-generated deepfakes and to respond to lawful requests in investigations involving online abuse and other cybercrime threats. Roblox agreed to integrate identity checks with the Philippine Identification System and establish a local office by October.

sections.heading: Platform commitments
paragraphs: Roblox also committed to default public controls, chat monitoring aimed at detecting violent tendencies, coordination with gaming communities and safeguards intended to limit children's communication to users in their age group.

Philippine officials and Meta representatives are expected to meet in September to discuss information-sharing protocols. The protocol has not yet been finalized in a memorandum of understanding or agreement.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The commitments followed official concern about online grooming, child exploitation, abusive content and the use of deepfakes. The emailed brief's claim of a universal 15-minute takedown standard was not supported by the independently reviewed reporting and is not included here.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Age assurance, parental controls and rapid moderation can reduce exposure to harmful material, but implementation details, privacy protections and enforcement standards will determine whether the commitments produce meaningful safety improvements.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The September talks should clarify how Meta's information-sharing process will work in lawful investigations, while Roblox still has to implement its PhilSys integration, local office and age-group safeguards.
